target.description: Resolve CDLI as one evolving modern scholarly digital-resource Work for A02, distinguish it from its operators, releases, artifact records, physical objects, images, inscriptions, publications and derived datasets, and preserve current field-level provenance, rights and currentness controls without acquiring content.
required_properties: project and scholarly-resource identity across founding and current official documentation
artifact metadata fields and uncertainty relations
search, API, linked-data and export capabilities separated from authority
metadata, text, image, software and publication rights separated by layer
current 2026 activity evidence without inventing an immutable release
fresh evidence about manual, scripted and LLM-assisted metadata production
future exact artifact and release reconciliation route
acceptable_substitutions: a dated official project page for current service activity
an exact versioned export only for a future release-level laboratory Item
a holding-institution record or original publication for field-level artifact corroboration

channels.source_name: CDLI official documentation and Max Planck founding preprint
channels.interface_version: current CDLI documentation checked 2026-08-12; founding preprint version 2001-08-21
channels.exact_query: Read the founding project statement and current About, API, artifact-field, search, terms, contribution and publishing documentation; resolve project scope, data layers, identifiers, uncertainty fields, update behavior and rights without treating availability as permission.

results.rationale: The early official account fixes the founding representation layers: transliterations, glossaries, digitized originals and photographic archives, with later analyses derived from them.

snapshot.reason: The institutional source was read remotely; no publication payload was required for a metadata-only planting.

results.title_as_displayed: About the Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative

declared_rights.statement: The page describes open online access but does not present one blanket reuse licence for every CDLI layer.

results.rationale: The current official page defines the international collaboration, broad chronological scope, text-and-image resource layers, partners and mutable current coverage figures.

snapshot.reason: The live page is intentionally treated as volatile dated evidence, not an immutable release.

results.title_as_displayed: CDLI API and Artifact metadata fields
results.rationale: The exact documentation separates artifact, composite, collection, publication, provenience, writing-place, archive, language, genre, material and uncertainty fields and exposes update events and linked-data representations.

snapshot.reason: No API response or bulk export was needed to establish the resource identity and future interface route.

results.title_as_displayed: CDLI Terms of Use, Contribute, and Publishing guidance

declared_rights.statement: Artifact photographs and original images are generally owned by holding institutions and image use is noncommercial; line art follows the named publication or creator; transliterations and translations may be reused according to academic practice with acknowledgement for considerable reuse.

results.rationale: The official pages prove that images, text, metadata contributions, software and publication links have different owners and workflows; no blanket licence may be inferred.

snapshot.reason: The terms URLs and dated research receipt preserve the evidence route; no governed payload entered ToS.

channels.source_name: Versioned primer and established digital-edition, linked-data, provenance and machine-corpus scholarship
channels.exact_query: Read field-shaping descriptions of CDLI identity and use; separate project Work, digital edition, linked-data projection, collection provenance and derived machine-learning dataset boundaries.

results.title_as_displayed: The Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative: A Primer

declared_rights.statement: Zenodo displays Copyright for the lesson rather than a Creative Commons licence.

results.rationale: The versioned 2025 guide is the strongest current scholarly overview of project history, catalogue structure, search, contribution and citation; its DOI identifies the primer, not CDLI itself.

snapshot.reason: The repository metadata was sufficient; the copyrighted lesson body was not imported.

results.title_as_displayed: Towards a Linked Open Data Edition of Sumerian Corpora

declared_rights.statement: ACL Anthology publication access applies to the paper; no upstream CDLI payload right is inferred.

results.rationale: The paper demonstrates that CDLI metadata and ATF can feed linked-data editions while remaining transformed, derived representations rather than source authority.

snapshot.reason: No paper or derived data payload was needed for this source-boundary planting.

results.title_as_displayed: Envisioning networked provenance data storytelling with American cuneiform collections

declared_rights.statement: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 applies to the article subject to credited third-party material.

results.rationale: The case study shows why findspot, custody, collector history, archival reconciliation, imaging and CDLI ingestion need separate item- and collection-level provenance relations.

snapshot.reason: The article was read remotely; no third-party collection image or record was copied.

results.title_as_displayed: CuneiML: A Machine Learning Dataset for Cuneiform Tablet Analysis

declared_rights.statement: The article and derived dataset declare their own terms; no right over upstream museum images is inferred.

results.rationale: The derived corpus demonstrates both the scale enabled by CDLI and the selection, image-availability, scraping and preprocessing bias introduced downstream.

snapshot.reason: No derived dataset or upstream image was admitted.

channels.source_name: Live CDLI activity, current institutional project evidence, 2026 metadata-production study and 2026 ML challenger
channels.interface_version: live project surfaces and publications checked 2026-08-12
channels.exact_query: Check whether CDLI is active in 2026, whether a current immutable release is exposed, how current metadata is actually produced and corrected, and which fresh ML claims are relevant without being promoted to source authority.

declared_rights.statement: Public viewing and contribution interfaces are available; rights remain layer-specific under the terms of use.

results.rationale: Accepted metadata updates dated May 2026 prove that the service and curation stream are live, but they do not name one immutable current database release.

snapshot.reason: A dated live-state observation is recorded; no mutable homepage snapshot was preserved.

results.rationale: The current institutional page corroborates more than 400,000 records, 738 provenienced sites, 1,284 collections and ongoing growth after the 2022 interface launch while naming current and former collaborators separately.

snapshot.reason: The live institutional record is retained as dated corroboration, not a release snapshot.

results.title_as_displayed: Semi-Automatic Annotation of Babylonian Cuneiform Texts

declared_rights.statement: The article is CC BY 4.0; its linked datasets have separate CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 3.0 licences.

results.rationale: The March 2026 peer-reviewed study directly documents source-dependent CDLI metadata creation and augmentation, mainly manual work aided by scripts and Microsoft Copilot, and explicit quality limits.

snapshot.reason: The paper was read remotely; no article or dataset payload entered the repository.

results.title_as_displayed: A novel network for classification of cuneiform tablet metadata

declared_rights.statement: The arXiv record exposes a distribution licence for the preprint; upstream training data and artifact rights require separate review.

results.rationale: The July 2026 point-cloud classifier is a relevant future A/B/C challenger under limited annotations, but as a preprint it cannot establish any artifact's identity, provenience, date, genre or reading.

snapshot.reason: No preprint, model, point cloud or code was acquired during source planting.

declared_rights.statement: The historical deposit's own record governs that release; it does not state the rights or identity of a 2026 export.

results.rationale: The exact 2022.01 deposit is valid historical release evidence but is rejected as a current 2026 database snapshot or currentness authority.

snapshot.reason: No historical bulk package was needed to plant the current resource identity.

channels.source_name: General web search after official and scholarly channels
channels.exact_query: Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative CDLI project corpus database current 2026

declared_rights.statement: Wikipedia page terms apply to the page; linked CDLI layers remain separately governed.

results.rationale: The page is useful for discoverability but cannot resolve current operator identity, exact release, field provenance, layer-specific rights or scholarly correctness better than the official and peer-reviewed sources.

snapshot.reason: The community summary is rejected as planting authority.

channel_comparison.notes: Best identity, field-model, API, update and layer-specific terms route; current coverage figures remain mutable and the terms are not one blanket licence.
Best route for resource history, digital-edition, linked-data, material-provenance and derived-dataset limits; not a substitute for live release evidence.
Proves 2026 activity and, crucially, source-dependent manual, scripted and LLM-assisted metadata production; no immutable 2026 bulk release was established.
Useful only for discoverability and terminology pressure after stronger channels; rejected as authority.
